title: Tiny, cute cup of hot cocoa
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='steam' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#cfe8ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#cfe8ff' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cfe8ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- steam -->
  <path d='M38 30 q-4 -5 0 -9 q4 -4 0 -9' fill='none' stroke='url(#steam)' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 27 q-4 -5 0 -9 q4 -4 0 -9' fill='none' stroke='url(#steam)' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 30 q-4 -5 0 -9 q4 -4 0 -9' fill='none' stroke='url(#steam)' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- saucer -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='32' ry='6' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='32' ry='6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='24' ry='3.5' fill='#e4e4e4'/>

  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M70 44 q16 2 16 13 q0 11 -16 12' fill='none' stroke='#e05a5a' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 50 q10 1 10 7 q0 6 -10 8' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- mug body -->
  <path d='M26 40 h48 l-4 34 q-1 8 -9 8 h-22 q-8 0 -9 -8 z' fill='#e8453c'/>
  <path d='M30 44 h40 l-3.5 30 q-0.8 6 -7 6 h-19 q-6 0 -7 -6 z' fill='#f25b52'/>
  <!-- mug shine -->
  <rect x='33' y='47' width='5' height='22' rx='2.5' fill='#ffb3ad' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- cocoa surface -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='24' ry='5' fill='#7a4a2b'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='20' ry='3.6' fill='#9a6238'/>

  <!-- heart latte art -->
  <path d='M50 42.5 q-5 -3 -5 -5.2 q0 -2 2.2 -2 q1.8 0 2.8 2 q1 -2 2.8 -2 q2.2 0 2.2 2 q0 2.2 -5 5.2 z' fill='#f7e6d2'/>

  <!-- marshmallows -->
  <rect x='35' y='36' width='10' height='7' rx='2.5' fill='#fffdf8'/>
  <rect x='35' y='36' width='10' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#ffe9ef'/>
  <rect x='56' y='35' width='9' height='6' rx='2.2' fill='#fffdf8'/>
  <rect x='56' y='35' width='9' height='2.2' rx='1.1' fill='#ffe9ef'/>

  <!-- tiny happy face on mug -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='60' r='2.4' fill='#5c1f1a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='60' r='2.4' fill='#5c1f1a'/>
  <circle cx='43.8' cy='59.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffd9d5'/>
  <circle cx='57.8' cy='59.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffd9d5'/>
  <path d='M46 66 q4 4 8 0' fill='none' stroke='#5c1f1a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='65' r='2.2' fill='#ff9a94' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='65' r='2.2' fill='#ff9a94' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
